 Three local men are facing federal charges after drug investigation found cocaine, guns and cash
 By News10NBC 
 --> 
 MGN.
 ROCHESTER, N.Y. — Three men from the Rochester area have been arrested and charged by federal authorities in a drug trafficking case.
 Rodney Stanley of Greece, Leonardo Gaskin of West Henrietta and Shanimba Nelson of Irondequoit all face charges including possession with intent to distribute cocaine and gun offenses.
 Federal prosecutors say investigators seized nearly 30 kilograms of suspected cocaine, four firearms and about $159,000 in cash during searches at multiple locations.
 Gaskin is still in custody while Nelson and Stanley have been released on conditions.
 If convicted, they face 10 years to life in prison.
